answer.summary: INV-0098 (IN-2026-00126, received 2026-10-15) appears to be a resubmission of invoice 0098 (IN-2026-00002), which is already in the queue from 2026-10-06. Both have the same invoice date (2026-10-02), the same total ($86,500.00) and the same service period (Aug 1 – Sep 30, 2026) for matter M-2207. The only difference is format: the earlier copy lists partner, associate, paralegal and disbursement lines, and this one is a single summary line. The sender email and the ACH account ending 0571 match the vendor master, and there have been no bank-detail changes, so this looks like an innocent resend, not fraud. Reject this copy as a duplicate and process the itemized original.
